objects.name: Analytic 1841
objects.description: For iOS, detect Data from Local System primarily during application vetting or controlled analysis rather than assuming a live device SOC feed. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App reads multiple files from Photos library, Files provider, or iCloud Drive in background or lock-adjacent state exceeding $FileReadRateThreshold$ within $DataCollectionWindow$]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Managed app accesses broad local data scope without user-initiated document picker interaction on supervised device]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Approved backup, sync, file manager, and media apps. Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: strict list — any unapproved app with broad file access is flagged.
Default 50 file reads within window across 3+ directories. Derive from approved backup app baseline. Tightening: 10 reads — catches targeted collection.
Default 3 distinct parent directories. Single-directory reads may be legitimate (photo editor); cross-directory reads indicate collection sweep.
